Print what each artifact was decided on, and what was decided

Usage: byrle artifact <COMMAND>

Commands:
  show       The latest decision on each artifact named: its features and its disposition, as a list, or as JSON Lines with -o json. Exits 1 when none is recorded
  export     Every decision recorded, oldest first, as JSON Lines
  reanalyse  Delete what was found in each artifact named, so the proxy analyses it again on its next fetch: install scripts, source, attestations, signatures, VirusTotal and each detector. Decisions are kept. Exits 1 when nothing is recorded on it
  help       Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)

Options:
  -h, --help  Print help
